meta.title: Vocabulary capture
meta.description: Learn the hard words before you read: capture pasted text, YouTube subtitles, local subtitle files, or web pages, let the agent pick high-value words and build flashcards, then study them in the Vocabulary capture sidebar panel. Adds the seekword tool and skill plus the panel with study view, wordbook search, favorites, and CSV export. Cards are generated by the session model following the seekword skill, so no extra API key or fee is needed. Content and cards are stored locally in ~/.dsh/seekword.
